verdict.rationale: Mastra Code documents a `/login` command for signing in with a supported provider account or subscription. It also supports multiple accounts per provider, such as Claude Max or Kimi For Coding subscriptions, so developers can use existing subscription plans to power the agent. Missing for 10: a complete documented list of supported subscription providers and the sign-in flow details, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can sign in with my existing product subscription plan to use the coding agent

citations.quote: If you have a supported provider account or subscription, run `/login` to sign in.
You can sign in with more than one account for the same provider — for example, two Claude Max accounts or four Kimi For Coding accounts.
